latest.headline: US markets closed today; MU rebounded from $548 to $601 Wednesday
latest.tldr: US stocks are shut for Thanksgiving and reopen Friday at 9:30 ET (8:30 SK) for a half day; MU opened Wednesday at $574.92 (−8.71%), fell to $548.13, closed at $601.25 (−4.53%) and last printed $615.26 after hours at 7:59 PM ET.
